title: Argentinian Empanada Pasta Bake
description: A German-inspired twist on a classic pasta bake, using Argentinian empanadas for added crust.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Cut empanadas in half and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat tomato sauce over medium heat.
Add cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with sauce until well combined.
Transfer pasta mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Arrange empanada halves on top of pasta mixture.
Sprinkle flaky cheese, mozzarella, and Parmesan evenly over empanada halves.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until empanadas are golden brown and cheese is melted.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
